svg.title: Heartbeat viewport contact focus-scope scar
svg.desc: A non-raster warm-wall diagram showing the existing Operator Overlay measuring live selected and keyboard-focused heartbeat controls, rejecting an offscreen selection as visible contact, choosing a visible keyboard-focused fallback, then distinguishing rebuild-caused heartbeat focus loss from direct focus moved to a different non-heartbeat overlay control. The focus-scope distinction exists as pure source policy and regression source; existing service owner consumption, Android runtime behavior, and TalkBack accessibility focus remain unproven.
svg.text: WARM WALL / EMPTY HEARTBEAT FOCUS ≠ REBUILD PROOF
FOCUS-SCOPE POLICY SOURCE YES • EXISTING-OWNER CONSUMPTION NO • TALKBACK FOCUS UNCLAIMED • NOT PHONE DELIVERY
Semantic id survives; live geometry says it does not own contact.
Stable in-place refresh + heartbeat focus vanished → no rebuild amnesty.
Rebuild + no direct focus anywhere → missing heartbeat focus may be mutation-caused.
Rebuild + focus now on STOP / Adam input / another overlay control → stale keyboard ticket dies.
No geometry-only Christmas twitch. Direct keyboard focus truth ≠ TalkBack accessibility focus. Source policy ≠ owner wiring.
No phone surface consumed. No second renderer hatched. Next seam: existing owner supplies mutation class + overlay-wide direct-focus presence.
